prompt: What production did the Winnipeg Daily Free Press claim was “too spicy – at least for this town” in June 1880?
answer: The production was **_Chili Sauce_**—a theatrical work whose title prompted the Winnipeg Daily Free Press’s pun that it was “too spicy—at least for this town” in June 1880.
